description_en: Repeat the Vega observation deliberately: focus, refocus, swap nothing - and confirm the fringe never leaves. This is physics, not error.
description_zh: 有意重复织女星观测：调焦、再调焦、什么都不换——确认彩边永远不会消失。这是物理，不是失误。
hint_text_en: Bring Vega into focus, then look for red on one side of the star and blue on the other.
hint_text_zh: 先把织女星调到清晰，再寻找星点两侧错开的红蓝边缘。
success_text_en: Repeat the Vega observation deliberately: focus, refocus, swap nothing - and confirm the fringe never leaves. This is physics, not error.
success_text_zh: 有意重复织女星观测：调焦、再调焦、什么都不换——确认彩边永远不会消失。这是物理，不是失误。

description_en: Build the Newtonian: external supports on the main blueprint, mirrors inside the Optical Tube Assembly, then collimate and point it at the Moon.
description_zh: 组装牛顿镜：主蓝图装外部支撑，镜筒组件里装镜面，完成准直后对准月球。
hint_text_en: Follow primary mirror to diagonal secondary to side eyepiece. Collimate the mirrors, focus Vega, and compare its clean edge with the refractor view.
hint_text_zh: 沿主镜、斜副镜、侧置目镜完成光路。准直镜面并对焦织女星，再与折射镜的彩色边缘比较。
success_text_en: Build the Newtonian: external supports on the main blueprint, mirrors inside the Optical Tube Assembly, then collimate and point it at the Moon.
success_text_zh: 组装牛顿镜：主蓝图装外部支撑，镜筒组件里装镜面，完成准直后对准月球。

description_en: Same star as L23 and L25 - now through mirrors. Compare what the edge of Vega looks like tonight.
description_zh: 和 L23、L25 同一颗星——这次经过的是镜面。比较今晚织女星的边缘。
hint_text_en: Follow primary mirror to diagonal secondary to side eyepiece. Collimate the mirrors, focus Vega, and compare its clean edge with the refractor view.
hint_text_zh: 沿主镜、斜副镜、侧置目镜完成光路。准直镜面并对焦织女星，再与折射镜的彩色边缘比较。
success_text_en: Same star as L23 and L25 - now through mirrors. Compare what the edge of Vega looks like tonight.
success_text_zh: 和 L23、L25 同一颗星——这次经过的是镜面。比较今晚织女星的边缘。

description_en: Use the side focuser on Saturn. A correct focus separates the pale disk from its ring without false color.
description_zh: 用侧置调焦座对准土星。正确合焦后，淡黄色圆面与光环清楚分开，而且没有虚假彩边。
hint_text_en: Focus slowly until the gap beside Saturn and the ring edge appear together.
hint_text_zh: 缓慢调焦，直到土星圆面两侧的空隙和光环边缘同时出现。
success_text_en: The mirror held Saturn and its rings in one clean, color-free image.
success_text_zh: 镜面把土星和光环呈现为一幅干净、无色差的图像。

description_en: Use Albireo as a collimation and angular-resolution test. A well-aligned Newtonian separates its gold and blue components.
description_zh: 用辇道增七检验准直与角分辨率。准直到位的牛顿镜能分开金色与蓝色两颗成员星。
hint_text_en: Collimate first, then focus until one blended point becomes a gold-and-blue pair.
hint_text_zh: 先完成准直，再调焦，直到一个混合光点分成金蓝两颗星。
success_text_en: The double star separated cleanly: alignment now changes what you can actually resolve.
success_text_zh: 双星被清楚分开：准直不再只是流程，而是真正改变了可分辨的细节。

title_zh: 六千五百光年外的恒星遗迹
description_en: Push the 150mm mirror to the Crab Nebula. Dark-adapt, use averted vision, and find the torn supernova glow.
description_zh: 把 150mm 主镜推向蟹状星云。完成暗适应并使用侧视法，寻找撕裂状的超新星遗迹微光。
hint_text_en: Keep the 25mm eyepiece, let your eyes adapt, then look just beside the faint filaments.
hint_text_zh: 保留 25mm 目镜，让眼睛适应黑暗，再看向暗弱丝状结构的旁边。
success_text_en: The Newtonian reached a stellar remnant about 6,500 light-years away.
success_text_zh: 牛顿镜触及了约 6,500 光年外的恒星遗迹。

title_zh: 两千九百万光年的草帽
description_en: Use the Newtonian on the Sombrero Galaxy. Hold averted vision long enough to separate its bright nucleus from the dust lane.
description_zh: 用牛顿镜观测草帽星系。保持侧视足够久，把亮核与横穿星系的尘埃带分开。
hint_text_en: Avoid high power. Dark-adapt fully and hold Shift beside the thin glow.
hint_text_zh: 不要追求高倍率。充分暗适应后，按住 Shift 看向细长微光旁边。
success_text_en: A galaxy nearly 30 million light-years away showed a nucleus and a dark lane.
success_text_zh: 将近 3,000 万光年外的星系显出了亮核与暗尘带。

description_en: Keep Uranus centered through Earth-rotation drift and focus until its blue-green light becomes a tiny steady disk instead of a field star.
description_zh: 在地球自转漂移中保持天王星居中并精细调焦，直到蓝绿色光点变成微小而稳定的圆面，而不是背景恒星。
hint_text_en: Make small manual corrections, then very small focus changes while the planet crosses center.
hint_text_zh: 用小幅手动修正保持位置，再在行星穿过中心时做极小幅度调焦。
success_text_en: The clean reflector image resolved the blue-green ice giant as a disk.
success_text_zh: 无色差的反射镜图像把蓝绿色冰巨星分辨成了圆面。

description_en: Poor seeing cannot erase a broad nebula, but sky glow can. Use the nebula filter and wait for the Dumbbell shape.
description_zh: 糟糕视宁度不会抹掉宽广星云，但明亮天空会。使用星云滤镜，等待哑铃状双瓣浮现。
hint_text_en: Select the nebula filter, keep low power, and wait through the boiling moments.
hint_text_zh: 选择星云滤镜，保持低倍率，并耐心等过大气剧烈扰动的时刻。
success_text_en: Filtering and patience revealed both lobes of the planetary nebula.
success_text_zh: 滤镜与耐心显出了这片行星状星云的两瓣结构。

description_en: Betelgeuse through mirrors: a deep orange-red giant with NO false fringe. A refractor would paint its edge blue and red - your Newtonian shows the star's own color.
description_zh: 用镜面看参宿四：一颗深橙红色的巨星，没有任何虚假彩边。折射镜会给它的边缘涂上红蓝——你的牛顿镜展示的是恒星自己的颜色。
hint_text_en: Follow primary mirror to diagonal secondary to side eyepiece. Collimate the mirrors, focus Vega, and compare its clean edge with the refractor view.
hint_text_zh: 沿主镜、斜副镜、侧置目镜完成光路。准直镜面并对焦织女星，再与折射镜的彩色边缘比较。
success_text_en: Betelgeuse through mirrors: a deep orange-red giant with NO false fringe. A refractor would paint its edge blue and red - your Newtonian shows the star's own color.
success_text_zh: 用镜面看参宿四：一颗深橙红色的巨星，没有任何虚假彩边。折射镜会给它的边缘涂上红蓝——你的牛顿镜展示的是恒星自己的颜色。

description_en: Complete a precise, filtered observation of the tiny Ring Nebula and prove the 150mm reflector can reveal structure beyond the Solar System.
description_zh: 完成一次精确的环状星云滤镜观测，证明 150mm 反射镜能够显出太阳系之外的结构。
hint_text_en: Collimate, dark-adapt, select the nebula filter, and use averted vision on the tiny smoke ring.
hint_text_zh: 完成准直和暗适应，选择星云滤镜，再用侧视法观察微小烟圈。
success_text_en: You graduated from nearby worlds to true deep sky with the Newtonian.
success_text_zh: 你已经用牛顿镜从近邻世界迈入了真正的深空。

title_en: A Wide Field for Seven Sisters
title_zh: 为昴星团保留整片天空
description_en: Build the 200mm Dobsonian and frame the Pleiades with the 30mm eyepiece. The upgrade begins with more light and a deliberately wide field.
description_zh: 组装 200mm 多布森，用 30mm 目镜完整框住昴星团。升级的第一课是更多光线，以及有意保留的宽视场。
hint_text_en: Use low power and keep both the bright core and outer members in the field.
hint_text_zh: 使用低倍率，让明亮核心与外围成员星同时留在视场中。
success_text_en: The simple rocker box carried a broad, bright field full of cluster members.
success_text_zh: 简单的摇箱底座托起了一个宽广、明亮、布满星团成员的视场。

description_en: Saturn now appears brighter in the 200mm mirror, but the rocker box has no motor. Nudge, settle, and inspect the rings.
description_zh: 在 200mm 主镜中土星更明亮，但摇箱没有马达。轻推、等待稳定，再检查光环。
hint_text_en: Let Saturn drift, nudge it ahead of center, then stop touching the tube while you inspect the rings.
hint_text_zh: 让土星漂移，轻推到中心前方，再松开镜筒观察光环。
success_text_en: You traded motorized tracking for aperture and kept the ringed planet under control.
success_text_zh: 你用机动追踪换来了更大口径，并仍然稳住了这颗有环行星。

title_en: Two Star Cities in One View
title_zh: 一幅视野里的两座星城
description_en: Use the wide-field Dobsonian view to hold both halves of the Double Cluster while manually correcting drift.
description_zh: 利用多布森的宽视场同时容纳双星团两部分，并在漂移中手动修正。
hint_text_en: Do not chase individual stars. Preserve the paired shape and use small, infrequent nudges.
hint_text_zh: 不要追逐单颗恒星。保留双星团整体形状，只做小而少的轻推。
success_text_en: Both clusters stayed together across a long manual observation.
success_text_zh: 在长时间手动观测中，两个星团始终共同留在视场里。

description_en: The 200mm mirror begins to resolve the grainy halo of a cluster 22,200 light-years away.
description_zh: 200mm 主镜开始把 22,200 光年外球状星团的颗粒状外晕分解成恒星。
hint_text_en: Dark-adapt, use averted vision on the halo, and keep moderate power for brightness.
hint_text_zh: 完成暗适应，对外晕使用侧视法，并保持中等倍率以保留亮度。
success_text_en: The larger mirror changed a fuzzy ball into a dense cluster with a resolved edge.
success_text_zh: 更大的主镜把模糊光球变成了边缘可分解的致密星团。

description_en: Combine 200mm aperture, the 30mm wide-field eyepiece, and a nebula filter to preserve the Lagoon Nebula and its dark lane.
description_zh: 结合 200mm 口径、30mm 宽视场目镜与星云滤镜，完整保留礁湖星云及其暗带。
hint_text_en: Use the nebula filter and low power; frame the broad mist instead of zooming into its center.
hint_text_zh: 使用星云滤镜和低倍率；框住宽广云气，而不是只放大中心。
success_text_en: Aperture and field worked together: the broad nebula stayed bright and complete.
success_text_zh: 口径与视场协同工作：宽广星云既明亮又完整。

description_en: The same Ring Nebula seen with the Newtonian is brighter now, but passing cloud makes timing the real challenge.
description_zh: 曾用牛顿镜看过的环状星云现在更明亮，但过境云层让观测时机成为真正挑战。
hint_text_en: Prepare focus and filter before the gap arrives, then hold the ring through the clear interval.
hint_text_zh: 云缝到来前先准备好焦点和滤镜，再在晴朗间隙稳住星云环。
success_text_en: The 200mm mirror recovered the ring quickly whenever the cloud opened.
success_text_zh: 每当云层打开，200mm 主镜都能迅速找回星云环。

title_en: A Needle Forty Million Light-Years Away
title_zh: 四千万光年外的一根银针
description_en: Use the 200mm mirror on NGC 4565. Preserve its long edge-on disk, central bulge, and dark lane during a low-altitude manual hold.
description_zh: 用 200mm 主镜观测 NGC 4565。在低空手动保持中同时保住细长侧向星系盘、中央核球与暗尘带。
hint_text_en: Keep low power, wait for steadier air, and use averted vision along the thin disk rather than its bright center.
hint_text_zh: 保持低倍率，等待大气稳定，并沿细长星系盘使用侧视法，不要只盯着明亮中心。
success_text_en: The 200mm Dobsonian held a galaxy about 40 million light-years away as a structured disk, not a nameless smudge.
success_text_zh: 200mm 多布森把约 4,000 万光年外的星系保持成具有结构的星系盘，而不是无名的模糊斑。

description_en: Use finder discipline, precise focus, and the 200mm light bucket to distinguish Neptune from the surrounding stars.
description_zh: 运用寻星镜定位、精细调焦和 200mm 集光能力，把海王星从周围恒星中分辨出来。
hint_text_en: Star-hop in the finder, center the faint blue point, then hold it long enough to confirm a tiny disk.
hint_text_zh: 用寻星镜跳星定位，把暗蓝光点居中，再保持足够久以确认微小圆面。
success_text_en: The Dobsonian reached the faintest major planet and held it by hand.
success_text_zh: 多布森触及了最暗弱的大行星，并由你的双手保持住。

title_zh: 两千三百万光年外的伴星系
description_en: Make the hardest Dobsonian hold on M51: dark-adapt, use averted vision, and keep the core and companion together.
description_zh: 在 M51 上完成最难的多布森保持：暗适应、侧视，并让主星系亮核与伴星系共同留在视场中。
hint_text_en: Use the 30mm eyepiece. Nudge ahead of drift, release the tube, and inspect the space between both cores.
hint_text_zh: 使用 30mm 目镜。朝漂移前方轻推后松手，观察两个亮核之间的区域。
success_text_en: Twenty-three million light-years away, the galaxy and its companion became one connected system.
success_text_zh: 在 2,300 万光年外，主星系与伴星系显成了相互连接的系统。

title_zh: 多布森大口径结业观测
description_en: Return to the Dumbbell Nebula and use the 200mm mirror to reveal the faint shell beyond the bright hourglass.
description_zh: 重访哑铃星云，用 200mm 主镜显出明亮沙漏之外的暗弱外壳。
hint_text_en: Filter, dark-adapt, and keep the full nebula in the low-power field during a long manual hold.
hint_text_zh: 使用滤镜、完成暗适应，并在长时间手动保持中让整片星云留在低倍率视场里。
success_text_en: The larger mirror revealed structure the Newtonian only hinted at. The Dobsonian upgrade has earned its place.
success_text_zh: 更大主镜显出了牛顿镜只能暗示的结构。多布森的升级价值已经得到证明。

description_en: Build the Cassegrain: a long telescope hidden in a short tube. First light on the Moon through the rear focuser.
description_zh: 组装卡塞格林：藏在短镜筒里的长望远镜。通过后置调焦座，用月球开光。
hint_text_en: The secondary is convex and sends light back through the primary. This is a different folded path, not a Newtonian copy.
hint_text_zh: 凸面副镜将光送回主镜中心孔。这是不同的折叠光路，不是牛顿镜的复制品。
success_text_en: Build the Cassegrain: a long telescope hidden in a short tube. First light on the Moon through the rear focuser.
success_text_zh: 组装卡塞格林：藏在短镜筒里的长望远镜。通过后置调焦座，用月球开光。

description_en: Long focal length means high magnification. Jupiter looks bigger than ever - if you can find it in the narrow field.
description_zh: 长焦距意味着高倍率。木星比以往任何时候都大——前提是你能在窄视场里找到它。
hint_text_en: The secondary is convex and sends light back through the primary. This is a different folded path, not a Newtonian copy.
hint_text_zh: 凸面副镜将光送回主镜中心孔。这是不同的折叠光路，不是牛顿镜的复制品。
success_text_en: Long focal length means high magnification. Jupiter looks bigger than ever - if you can find it in the narrow field.
success_text_zh: 长焦距意味着高倍率。木星比以往任何时候都大——前提是你能在窄视场里找到它。

description_en: A narrow field punishes sloppy aiming. Use the finder scope discipline you learned long ago.
description_zh: 窄视场惩罚粗糙的瞄准。用上你很久以前学会的寻星镜纪律。
hint_text_en: The secondary is convex and sends light back through the primary. This is a different folded path, not a Newtonian copy.
hint_text_zh: 凸面副镜将光送回主镜中心孔。这是不同的折叠光路，不是牛顿镜的复制品。
success_text_en: A narrow field punishes sloppy aiming. Use the finder scope discipline you learned long ago.
success_text_zh: 窄视场惩罚粗糙的瞄准。用上你很久以前学会的寻星镜纪律。

description_en: Mars is tiny. The folded path gives you the scale - the atmosphere decides if you keep it.
description_zh: 火星很小。折叠光路给了你放大倍数——大气决定你能不能保住它。
hint_text_en: Poor seeing ruins the 12mm view. Fit the 40mm eyepiece, focus carefully, and wait for the disk to settle.
hint_text_zh: 视宁度差时，12mm 目镜只会放大扰动。换上 40mm 目镜，仔细调焦并等待圆面稳定。
success_text_en: Mars is tiny. The folded path gives you the scale - the atmosphere decides if you keep it.
success_text_zh: 火星很小。折叠光路给了你放大倍数——大气决定你能不能保住它。

description_en: Venus sits low over the western horizon after sunset, and low air boils. Drop the power, trim the exposure until the phase edge returns, and wait for the brief steady moments.
description_zh: 日落之后，金星低悬在西方地平线附近，而低空的大气正在翻涌。降低倍率，收敛曝光直到相位边缘重新出现，并等待那些短暂的稳定瞬间。
hint_text_en: Keep the 40mm in place: high power only magnifies the turbulence. Reduce exposure until the crescent edge appears, then focus during a steady instant.
hint_text_zh: 保持使用 40mm 目镜：高倍率只会放大扰动。降低曝光直到弯月边缘显现，再在稳定瞬间完成调焦。
success_text_en: Venus is a phase, not a surface. Low altitude decides how much you can see - power cannot buy back steady air.
success_text_zh: 金星呈现的是相位，而不是表面。能看到多少取决于它的高度——倍率买不回平稳的大气。
safety_notice_en: Safety: this session begins only after the Sun is fully below the horizon. Never point a telescope at or near the Sun - concentrated sunlight causes permanent eye injury in an instant.
safety_notice_zh: 安全提示：本次观测只在太阳完全落到地平线以下后开始。绝不可将望远镜指向太阳或太阳附近——被聚焦的阳光会在瞬间造成不可逆的眼睛损伤。
observation_success_feedback_en: The bright crescent holds still for a moment, its edge clean against the twilight.
observation_success_feedback_zh: 明亮的弯月短暂地稳定下来，边缘在暮色中清晰利落。

description_en: At high magnification the sky drifts FAST across the narrow field. Keep Mars centered.
description_zh: 高倍率下，天空在窄视场里漂移得飞快。让火星保持居中。
hint_text_en: The secondary is convex and sends light back through the primary. This is a different folded path, not a Newtonian copy.
hint_text_zh: 凸面副镜将光送回主镜中心孔。这是不同的折叠光路，不是牛顿镜的复制品。
success_text_en: At high magnification the sky drifts FAST across the narrow field. Keep Mars centered.
success_text_zh: 高倍率下，天空在窄视场里漂移得飞快。让火星保持居中。

description_en: Turn the folded focal length on the Moon: single craters fill the eyepiece.
description_zh: 把折叠焦距对准月球：单个环形山就能填满目镜。
hint_text_en: The secondary is convex and sends light back through the primary. This is a different folded path, not a Newtonian copy.
hint_text_zh: 凸面副镜将光送回主镜中心孔。这是不同的折叠光路，不是牛顿镜的复制品。
success_text_en: Turn the folded focal length on the Moon: single craters fill the eyepiece.
success_text_zh: 把折叠焦距对准月球：单个环形山就能填满目镜。

title_zh: 两台反射镜，同一颗冰巨星
description_en: You logged Uranus once already, through the Newtonian. Tonight the Cassegrain takes the same target. Compare honestly: acquisition, field width, image scale, steadiness.
description_zh: 你已经用牛顿镜记录过一次天王星。今晚换成卡塞格林观测同一个目标。诚实地比较：寻找难度、视野宽度、成像尺度、稳定程度。
hint_text_en: The long folded focus gives you image scale, not field. Uranus should stop looking like a star and become a tiny blue-green disk.
hint_text_zh: 折叠光路带来的是成像尺度，而不是视野。天王星应当不再像一颗恒星，而变成一个微小的蓝绿色圆面。
success_text_en: Wide field finds it; long focus resolves it. Neither mirror is simply better - they answer different questions.
success_text_zh: 宽视野负责找到它，长焦距负责分辨它。两种镜子没有谁全面更好——它们回答的是不同的问题。
comparison_baseline_en: Your Newtonian record from Night 32: wide field, easy to find, but a very small disk.
comparison_baseline_zh: 你在第 32 晚的牛顿镜记录：视野宽、容易找到，但圆面非常小。
observation_success_feedback_en: No longer a point: a small, flat, blue-green disk holding steady at high power.
observation_success_feedback_zh: 它不再是一个光点：一个小而平坦的蓝绿色圆面，在高倍率下稳稳地停在视野中。

description_en: Clouds cross a narrow field quickly and completely. Time your observation between them.
description_zh: 云穿过窄视场又快又彻底。在云缝之间安排你的观测。
hint_text_en: The secondary is convex and sends light back through the primary. This is a different folded path, not a Newtonian copy.
hint_text_zh: 凸面副镜将光送回主镜中心孔。这是不同的折叠光路，不是牛顿镜的复制品。
success_text_en: Clouds cross a narrow field quickly and completely. Time your observation between them.
success_text_zh: 云穿过窄视场又快又彻底。在云缝之间安排你的观测。

description_en: Graduation night. Find Neptune by coordinates, confirm it is a disk and not a star, hold it steady - then find the faint spark of Triton beside it and log the pair as a system.
description_zh: 结业之夜。按坐标找到海王星，确认它是圆面而不是恒星，稳定地追踪它——然后在它旁边找到海卫一那点微弱的光芒，并把这一对作为一个系统记录下来。
hint_text_en: Neptune first, then Triton. The moon is far fainter than the planet, so let your eye settle before you judge the field.
hint_text_zh: 先找海王星，再找海卫一。卫星比行星暗得多，所以先让眼睛适应，再判断视野里的光点。
success_text_en: A blue disk at the edge of the Solar System, with its own moon beside it. The folded path earned you this one.
success_text_zh: 太阳系边缘的一个蓝色圆面，旁边还伴着它自己的卫星。这一幕是折叠光路为你赢来的。

secondary_target.label_zh: 在海王星旁确认海卫一
secondary_target.hint_en: Click the faint point beside Neptune to confirm Triton; first center and focus the planet.
secondary_target.hint_zh: 点击海王星旁的微弱光点，确认海卫一；先保持行星居中并调清楚。
secondary_target.found_en: Triton confirmed. You have logged a planetary system, not just a planet.
secondary_target.found_zh: 已确认海卫一。你记录下的是一个行星系统，而不只是一颗行星。

observation_success_feedback_en: Neptune holds as a small blue disk, and the faint point of Triton sits just off its edge.
observation_success_feedback_zh: 海王星稳定地呈现为一个小小的蓝色圆面，海卫一微弱的光点就在它边缘之外。

description_en: Build the Gregorian: light passes through a real focus BEFORE the concave secondary. Alignment must be stricter than anything so far.
description_zh: 组装格里高利镜：光线先穿过一个真实焦点，再到达凹面副镜。对准要求比以往任何一台都严格。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: Build the Gregorian: light passes through a real focus BEFORE the concave secondary. Alignment must be stricter than anything so far.
success_text_zh: 组装格里高利镜：光线先穿过一个真实焦点，再到达凹面副镜。对准要求比以往任何一台都严格。

description_en: You observed Sirius with the refractor long ago. Feel where the Gregorian snaps into focus and compare.
description_zh: 很久以前你用折射镜看过天狼星。感受格里高利镜"咔哒"合焦的位置，并做比较。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: You observed Sirius with the refractor long ago. Feel where the Gregorian snaps into focus and compare.
success_text_zh: 很久以前你用折射镜看过天狼星。感受格里高利镜"咔哒"合焦的位置，并做比较。

description_en: The extra focus makes the image upright and high-contrast. Vega, once more, without any fringe.
description_zh: 多出的焦点让成像正立且高对比。再看一次织女星——依然没有任何彩边。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: The extra focus makes the image upright and high-contrast. Vega, once more, without any fringe.
success_text_zh: 多出的焦点让成像正立且高对比。再看一次织女星——依然没有任何彩边。

description_en: Small target, strict optics. Every arcsecond of alignment error shows on Mars.
description_zh: 小目标，严苛光学。每一角秒的对准误差都会显现在火星上。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: Small target, strict optics. Every arcsecond of alignment error shows on Mars.
success_text_zh: 小目标，严苛光学。每一角秒的对准误差都会显现在火星上。

description_en: Mars is small even in a large telescope. What the Gregorian defends is contrast: hold the focus, wait for steady air, and the dark markings and a hint of polar frost separate from the orange disk.
description_zh: 即使用大望远镜，火星依然很小。格里高利镜守护的是对比度：稳住焦点，等待平稳的大气，暗色区域和极冠的微弱痕迹就会从橙色圆面中浮现出来。
hint_text_en: Do not chase size. Fine-tune the focus and watch the disk: faint dark patches appear only when the air is still.
hint_text_zh: 不要追求更大。细调焦点并注视圆面：只有大气平稳时，淡淡的暗色斑块才会显现。
success_text_en: Low-contrast detail is won by focus and steady air, not by magnification. That is this design's quiet strength.
success_text_zh: 低对比度的细节靠的是调焦和平稳的大气，而不是倍率。这正是这套设计低调的强项。
observation_success_feedback_en: A small orange disk with a soft dark marking across it and a pale brightening at one pole.
observation_success_feedback_zh: 一个小小的橙色圆面，上面横着一道柔和的暗色纹理，一侧极区泛着淡淡的亮色。

description_en: Can the two-mirror fold handle a faint nebula? Find out on Orion.
description_zh: 双镜折叠能应付暗弱星云吗？在猎户座上找到答案。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: Can the two-mirror fold handle a faint nebula? Find out on Orion.
success_text_zh: 双镜折叠能应付暗弱星云吗？在猎户座上找到答案。

description_en: Drift correction through a folded path: keep Sirius centered.
description_zh: 在折叠光路中做漂移修正：让天狼星保持居中。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: Drift correction through a folded path: keep Sirius centered.
success_text_zh: 在折叠光路中做漂移修正：让天狼星保持居中。

description_en: Poor seeing on a strict instrument: learn which errors are yours and which are the sky's.
description_zh: 严苛仪器遇上糟糕视宁度：分清哪些误差是你的，哪些是天空的。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: Poor seeing on a strict instrument: learn which errors are yours and which are the sky's.
success_text_zh: 严苛仪器遇上糟糕视宁度：分清哪些误差是你的，哪些是天空的。

description_en: Newtonian, Cassegrain, Gregorian - each fold has a reason. Prove you can explain all three on golden Arcturus.
description_zh: 牛顿、卡塞格林、格里高利——每种折叠都有理由。用金色的大角星证明你能说清这三者。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: Newtonian, Cassegrain, Gregorian - each fold has a reason. Prove you can explain all three on golden Arcturus.
success_text_zh: 牛顿、卡塞格林、格里高利——每种折叠都有理由。用金色的大角星证明你能说清这三者。

description_en: The last ground telescope exam. Every mirror you own still fights one enemy: the atmosphere itself.
description_zh: 最后一场地面望远镜考试。你拥有的每一面镜子仍在对抗同一个敌人：大气本身。
hint_text_en: Both mirrors are concave in this system. The secondary sits beyond the first focus.
hint_text_zh: 该系统中的两面镜子都是凹面，副镜位于第一个焦点之后。
success_text_en: The last ground telescope exam. Every mirror you own still fights one enemy: the atmosphere itself.
success_text_zh: 最后一场地面望远镜考试。你拥有的每一面镜子仍在对抗同一个敌人：大气本身。

description_en: Assemble the segmented space telescope: 18 mirror segments, an infrared instrument package, and a tennis-court sunshield.
description_zh: 组装分段式空间望远镜：18 块镜片、红外仪器包，和一面网球场大小的遮阳板。
hint_text_en: Segments must act as one surface before the infrared instrument can form a useful image.
hint_text_zh: 分段镜片必须像一个整体工作，红外仪器才能形成有效图像。
success_text_en: Assemble the segmented space telescope: 18 mirror segments, an infrared instrument package, and a tennis-court sunshield.
success_text_zh: 组装分段式空间望远镜：18 块镜片、红外仪器包，和一面网球场大小的遮阳板。
new_mechanic_en: First light: full deploy + basic NIRCam imaging.
new_mechanic_zh: 首光：完整部署 + 基础 NIRCam 成像。

description_en: Leave the familiar Orion view behind. Aim NIRCam at Carina's Cosmic Cliffs and reveal newborn stars hidden inside a wall of dust.
description_zh: 离开熟悉的猎户座画面。用 NIRCam 对准船底座星云的“宇宙悬崖”，揭示藏在尘埃墙内部的新生恒星。
hint_text_en: Merge the 18 mirror segments, then use NIRCam's star-forming filter. The blue-white points inside the dust are the discovery.
hint_text_zh: 先让 18 块镜片合并成一个波前，再使用 NIRCam 的恒星形成滤镜。尘埃内部显现的蓝白星点才是本关发现。
success_text_en: NIRCam looked through the cliff-like dust wall and resolved a hidden nursery of newborn stars that the earlier optical telescope could not show.
success_text_zh: NIRCam 穿透悬崖状尘埃墙，分辨出早期光学望远镜无法呈现的新生恒星摇篮。
new_mechanic_en: Infrared first light: reveal stars embedded behind an opaque dust wall.
new_mechanic_zh: 红外首光：显现被不透明尘埃墙遮住的内嵌恒星。

description_en: Return to Carina with MIRI. NIRCam found the stars; now map the cooler dust that will collapse into the next generation.
description_zh: 带着 MIRI 再访船底座星云。NIRCam 找到了恒星；现在描绘将孕育下一代恒星的低温尘埃。
hint_text_en: Switch from NIRCam to the colder MIRI channel and hold the thermal state. Warm instruments would bury this faint dust signal in their own glow.
hint_text_zh: 从 NIRCam 切换到温度更低的 MIRI 通道并保持热控。温热的仪器会用自身辐射淹没微弱的冷尘埃信号。
success_text_en: MIRI separated cool dust from the hot newborn stars. The second observation revealed different matter instead of repeating the first image.
success_text_zh: MIRI 将低温尘埃与炽热的新生恒星分离开来。第二次观测揭示的是不同物质，而不是重复第一张图。
new_mechanic_en: New instrument MIRI: needs the coldest thermal state to see cold dust.
new_mechanic_zh: 新仪器 MIRI：需要最低温热环境才能看到冷尘埃。

description_en: A warm infrared telescope observes only itself. Manage the sunshield so the instruments stay cold.
description_zh: 发热的红外望远镜只能观测它自己。用好遮阳板，让仪器保持低温。
hint_text_en: Segments must act as one surface before the infrared instrument can form a useful image.
hint_text_zh: 分段镜片必须像一个整体工作，红外仪器才能形成有效图像。
success_text_en: A warm infrared telescope observes only itself. Manage the sunshield so the instruments stay cold.
success_text_zh: 发热的红外望远镜只能观测它自己。用好遮阳板，让仪器保持低温。
new_mechanic_en: Spectroscopy: NIRSpec + mid-IR reads redshifted light.
new_mechanic_zh: 光谱：NIRSpec + 中红外读取红移光。

description_en: Point the telescope AND keep Sun, Earth and Moon behind the shield - both at once.
description_zh: 既要指向目标，又要让太阳、地球和月亮全躲在遮阳板后——两者必须同时成立。
hint_text_en: Segments must act as one surface before the infrared instrument can form a useful image.
hint_text_zh: 分段镜片必须像一个整体工作，红外仪器才能形成有效图像。
success_text_en: Point the telescope AND keep Sun, Earth and Moon behind the shield - both at once.
success_text_zh: 既要指向目标，又要让太阳、地球和月亮全躲在遮阳板后——两者必须同时成立。
new_mechanic_en: Attitude limit: the target is near a forbidden sun angle - re-point carefully.
new_mechanic_zh: 姿态限制：目标靠近禁止的太阳角——需谨慎重新指向。

description_en: Andromeda in infrared shows warm dust lanes invisible from the ground. Map them.
description_zh: 红外下的仙女座露出地面看不见的温暖尘埃带。把它们描绘出来。
hint_text_en: Segments must act as one surface before the infrared instrument can form a useful image.
hint_text_zh: 分段镜片必须像一个整体工作，红外仪器才能形成有效图像。
success_text_en: Andromeda in infrared shows warm dust lanes invisible from the ground. Map them.
success_text_zh: 红外下的仙女座露出地面看不见的温暖尘埃带。把它们描绘出来。

description_en: A visible-light telescope sees the Horsehead as a dark silhouette. Use infrared to look through that dust and recover the hidden star field.
description_zh: 可见光望远镜只能把马头星云看成遮光暗影。使用红外穿透尘埃，找回被遮住的恒星背景。
hint_text_en: Use NIRCam and a long integration. The important evidence is not a brighter silhouette, but stars appearing through the thinner parts of the dust.
hint_text_zh: 使用 NIRCam 和长时间积分。关键证据不是暗影变亮，而是恒星开始透过较薄的尘埃区域显现。
success_text_en: Infrared changed the Horsehead from an opaque cutout into a translucent cloud crossed by hidden stars. This is a wavelength comparison, not a repeated optical picture.
success_text_zh: 红外把不透明的马头暗影变成了可被恒星穿透的半透明尘埃云。这是波段差异，而不是重复一张光学照片。
new_mechanic_en: Wavelength comparison: infrared turns an optical dark silhouette into a translucent stellar field.
new_mechanic_zh: 波段对比：红外把光学暗影转化为可穿透的恒星视场。

description_en: Betelgeuse is cool and red - a natural infrared beacon. Measure the giant.
description_zh: 参宿四又冷又红——天生的红外灯塔。测量这颗巨星。
hint_text_en: Segments must act as one surface before the infrared instrument can form a useful image.
hint_text_zh: 分段镜片必须像一个整体工作，红外仪器才能形成有效图像。
success_text_en: Betelgeuse is cool and red - a natural infrared beacon. Measure the giant.
success_text_zh: 参宿四又冷又红——天生的红外灯塔。测量这颗巨星。
new_mechanic_en: Cool giant with MIRI: tight cold requirement + saturation risk on a bright star.
new_mechanic_zh: 用 MIRI 观测冷巨星：严格低温要求 + 亮星过曝风险。

description_en: Deploy, cool, point, observe: run a complete infrared session by yourself.
description_zh: 展开、降温、指向、观测：独立完成一次完整的红外观测。
hint_text_en: Segments must act as one surface before the infrared instrument can form a useful image.
hint_text_zh: 分段镜片必须像一个整体工作，红外仪器才能形成有效图像。
success_text_en: Deploy, cool, point, observe: run a complete infrared session by yourself.
success_text_zh: 展开、降温、指向、观测：独立完成一次完整的红外观测。
new_mechanic_en: Emission-line filter: isolate hot ionised gas and map it to colour.
new_mechanic_zh: 发射线滤镜：分离高温电离气体并映射为颜色。

description_en: You now observe light no eye can see. There is radiation even "colder" than infrared - and for that, we have a giant in Guizhou.
description_zh: 你已能观测眼睛看不见的光。还有比红外"更冷"的辐射——为了它，我们在贵州有一个巨人。
hint_text_en: Segments must act as one surface before the infrared instrument can form a useful image.
hint_text_zh: 分段镜片必须像一个整体工作，红外仪器才能形成有效图像。
success_text_en: You now observe light no eye can see. There is radiation even "colder" than infrared - and for that, we have a giant in Guizhou.
success_text_zh: 你已能观测眼睛看不见的光。还有比红外"更冷"的辐射——为了它，我们在贵州有一个巨人。
new_mechanic_en: Graduation: full pipeline, deep stack, cosmic-ray rejection and science report.
new_mechanic_zh: 毕业关：完整管线、深叠加、宇宙线剔除与科学报告。

description_en: Set up FAST: active dish, suspended feed cabin, signal processor. There is no eyepiece - there never will be.
description_zh: 搭建 FAST：主动反射面、悬吊馈源舱、信号处理器。这里没有目镜——永远不会有。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: Set up FAST: active dish, suspended feed cabin, signal processor. There is no eyepiece - there never will be.
success_text_zh: 搭建 FAST：主动反射面、悬吊馈源舱、信号处理器。这里没有目镜——永远不会有。

radio_profile.result_en: The commissioning run recovered PSR B0329+54 as a stable repeating radio source.
radio_profile.result_zh: 联调观测成功恢复了 PSR B0329+54 的稳定重复射电脉冲。

description_en: Sweep the frequency band until the pulsar's repeating pulse rises out of the noise.
description_zh: 扫过频段，直到脉冲星重复的脉冲从噪声中浮现。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: Sweep the frequency band until the pulsar's repeating pulse rises out of the noise.
success_text_zh: 扫过频段，直到脉冲星重复的脉冲从噪声中浮现。

radio_profile.result_en: A carefully placed receiver window preserved the pulsar while rejecting nearby transmitters.
radio_profile.result_zh: 精确设置的接收频窗保留了脉冲星信号，同时避开了邻近发射源。

description_en: Read the trace and measure the period: 0.714 seconds per revolution of a dead star.
description_zh: 读取轨迹并测量周期：一颗死亡恒星每 0.714 秒自转一圈。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: Read the trace and measure the period: 0.714 seconds per revolution of a dead star.
success_text_zh: 读取轨迹并测量周期：一颗死亡恒星每 0.714 秒自转一圈。

radio_profile.result_en: The measured 714.5 ms repetition revealed the neutron star's remarkably steady rotation.
radio_profile.result_zh: 测得的 714.5 毫秒重复周期揭示了中子星极其稳定的自转。

description_en: A radio telescope points with signal strength. Move the feed until the pulse peaks - that is your pulsar.
description_zh: 射电望远镜靠信号强度指向。移动馈源直到脉冲最强——那就是你的脉冲星。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: A radio telescope points with signal strength. Move the feed until the pulse peaks - that is your pulsar.
success_text_zh: 射电望远镜靠信号强度指向。移动馈源直到脉冲最强——那就是你的脉冲星。

radio_profile.result_en: Fine feed-cabin control held the beam on the pulsar despite a persistent pointing drift.
radio_profile.result_zh: 精细馈源舱控制抵消了持续指向漂移，使波束稳定保持在脉冲星上。

description_en: Tonight the pulse barely clears the noise floor. Tune finer, read more carefully.
description_zh: 今晚脉冲勉强高出噪声底。调得更细，读得更仔细。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: Tonight the pulse barely clears the noise floor. Tune finer, read more carefully.
success_text_zh: 今晚脉冲勉强高出噪声底。调得更细，读得更仔细。

radio_profile.result_en: A narrow, quiet frequency window made the weak pulsar measurable above the receiver noise.
radio_profile.result_zh: 狭窄而安静的频率窗口让微弱脉冲星从接收机噪声中变得可测量。

description_en: Longer listening makes faint pulses add up. Radio astronomy rewards patience with certainty.
description_zh: 听得更久，微弱脉冲就会累加起来。射电天文用确定性回报耐心。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: Longer listening makes faint pulses add up. Radio astronomy rewards patience with certainty.
success_text_zh: 听得更久，微弱脉冲就会累加起来。射电天文用确定性回报耐心。

radio_profile.result_en: Long integration averaged random noise away until the same weak pulse returned with statistical confidence.
radio_profile.result_zh: 长时间积分逐渐平均掉随机噪声，最终以统计可信度恢复出同一微弱脉冲。

description_en: The feed cabin hangs from cables above the dish. Practice fine positioning against a moving sky.
description_zh: 馈源舱靠缆索悬在反射面上方。练习在移动的天空下做精细定位。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: The feed cabin hangs from cables above the dish. Practice fine positioning against a moving sky.
success_text_zh: 馈源舱靠缆索悬在反射面上方。练习在移动的天空下做精细定位。

radio_profile.result_en: The suspended feed cabin settled inside its cable-load envelope and held the moving radio source.
radio_profile.result_zh: 悬吊馈源舱在缆索载荷包线内稳定下来，并持续跟住移动的射电源。

description_en: Interference is radio astronomy's light pollution. Learn to tell the pulsar from human noise.
description_zh: 干扰就是射电天文的光污染。学会把脉冲星和人造噪声区分开。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: Interference is radio astronomy's light pollution. Learn to tell the pulsar from human noise.
success_text_zh: 干扰就是射电天文的光污染。学会把脉冲星和人造噪声区分开。

radio_profile.result_en: After radar, satellite, burst, and power-line contamination were removed, the celestial pulse remained.
radio_profile.result_zh: 雷达、卫星、突发通信和电力线污染被剔除后，天体脉冲仍然存在。

description_en: Tune, localize, measure, record - one complete radio observation, alone.
description_zh: 调谐、定位、测量、记录——独立完成一次完整的射电观测。
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.
hint_text_zh: 无线电天文收集肉眼看不见的电波，再把它们转换成频谱或脉冲轨迹。
success_text_en: Tune, localize, measure, record - one complete radio observation, alone.
success_text_zh: 调谐、定位、测量、记录——独立完成一次完整的射电观测。

radio_profile.result_en: Correct dispersion removal aligned the pulse across every receiver sub-band before folding.
radio_profile.result_zh: 正确消除色散后，脉冲在所有接收子频段中对齐，随后才能可靠折叠。

description_en: Data IS the observation - you have proven it. One question remains: what happens when every window opens at once?
description_zh: 数据本身就是观测——你已经证明了这一点。只剩一个问题：当所有窗口同时打开，会发生什么？
hint_text_en: Radio astronomy collects waves you cannot see, then turns them into a spectrum or pulse trace.

success_text_en: Data IS the observation - you have proven it. One question remains: what happens when every window opens at once?
success_text_zh: 数据本身就是观测——你已经证明了这一点。只剩一个问题：当所有窗口同时打开，会发生什么？

radio_profile.result_en: Your complete FAST reduction established a stable dispersed pulsar candidate worthy of follow-up observation.
radio_profile.result_zh: 你独立完成的 FAST 数据处理确认了一个稳定的色散脉冲星候选，值得继续跟踪观测。
